interventions.detail: Installed soundfile: qwen_agent/utils/utils.py imports it unconditionally but setup.py doesn't declare it, so import qwen_agent failed
apt-get install zstd, which the Ollama install script needs to extract its archive
Installed Ollama, started 'ollama serve' manually (no systemd) and ran 'ollama pull qwen3:1.7b'; the README only links to external Qwen2 docs
